title: Committee Hearing Room
purpose: Oversight and hearings surfaces; accountability messaging.
story: A committee hearing room before the hearing — a raised bench above a lone witness table, the asymmetry of scrutiny made plain.
environment: A formal hearing room, a curved raised bench facing a single table across an open floor, panelling fading into shadow.
architecture: Institutional interior — a tiered presiding bench, a panelled dado, a high cornice receding into gloom.
composition: The raised bench dominant on the upper axis, the small witness table below and forward, warm light pooling between them, darkness beyond.
continuityNotes: Holds the set's near-black grade with one warm source and brass-on-black palette consistent with scene-01.
